message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a centered, large-statured man in a gray uniform. He wears a dark, peaked cap with a brim that casts a deep shadow over his upper face, obscuring his eyes. He has a thick dark mustache and a prominent chin. His uniform consists of a short-sleeved gray shirt with two chest pockets, dark trousers, and black shoes. His left hand is on his hip, while his right hand holds a green leash.

The leash is attached to a thick, green-covered book positioned on the lower left. The book is open, revealing jagged white teeth-like shapes along its upper and lower inner edges and a long, red ribbon extending from within like a tongue.

The background is a solid orange color. Prominent white text at the top reads "TEMPO," with smaller text below it. Bold black text to the left reads "KUHAP! LALU DITANGKAP." Below this, a smaller paragraph of black Indonesian text is visible. The bottom right corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and publication details including "24-30 NOVEMBER 2025" and "RP 60.000."
